observation.command:
cd /workspace
# debates.rb
sed -i 's/projekt: projekt,/projekt_phase: projekt.debate_phases.first,/g; s/terms_of_service: "1")/resource_terms: "1")/g' db/dev_seeds/debates.rb
# notifications.rb
sed -i 's/projekt: Projekt.all.sample,/projekt_phase: Projekt.all.sample.debate_phases.sample,/g; s/terms_of_service: "1")/resource_terms: "1")/g' db/dev_seeds/notifications.rb
# proposals.rb
sed -i 's/projekt: projekt,/projekt_phase: projekt.proposal_phases.first,/g; s/terms_of_service: "1",/resource_terms: "1",/g' db/dev_seeds/proposals.rb
# polls.rb
sed -i 's/projekt: Projekt.first,/projekt_phase: Projekt.first.voting_phases.first,/g' db/dev_seeds/polls.rb
# legislation_proposals.rb
sed -i 's/terms_of_service: "1",/resource_terms: "1",/g' db/dev_seeds/legislation_proposals.rb
# budgets.rb investments
sed -i 's/terms_of_service: "1"/resource_terms: "1"/g' db/dev_seeds/budgets.rb
grep -n "projekt:" db/dev_seeds/*.rb; echo "---terms---"; grep -rn "terms_of_service" db/dev_seeds/*.rb
